items.headline: Modeling Information Blackouts in Missing Not-At-Random Time Series Data
items.summary:
arXiv:2601.01480v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Traffic forecasting systems rely on fixed sensor networks that frequently exhibit contiguous blackouts. Such outages are usually treated as ignorable missingness, although dropout can depend on unobserved traffic conditions. We study this possibility with an MNAR-aware latent state-space model that combines linear traffic dynamics with a Bernoulli missingness channel whose probability depends on the latent state. items.summary:
